Name: Auto-Sorter Building
Author: AtlasV1224
Description:
Manually sorting your items always takes so much time, add in a bunch of mods that add new items and it takes even longer!

This mod can help! It adds a new building that can be built by Robin that
automatically sorts all your items by catagory into the chests on the inside
that you place!



[img]https://atlasv.info/images/SDVModding/AutoSorterBuilding/usage.png[/img][u][b][size=4]
[/size][/b][/u]To use it, this is all you need to do :[list]
[*]Buy the building from Robin and wait for it to be constructed.
[*]Place a sign that can have an item displayed on it anywhere in the building.
[*]Place any kind of chest directly below the sign.
[*]Place an item on the sign with a catagory that matches the items you want to be stored in the chest.
[*]Then head on outside and place your items in the box to the right of the door.
[*]When you close the box your items will be sorted automatically!
[/list]The building can support any number of chests with signs inside!


There are also some fall back features so that if it doesn't find a chest that matches, your items will still be safe!
[list]
[*]If the building finds 2 chests with catagories that match but one doesn't
have enough space, It will place the remaining items in the other chest.[*]if the building finds a chest with a catagory match but doesn't have
enough space, or there isn't a chest for that catagory, it will place the items in chest below an empty sign.[*]If the building can't do either of these the items will be placed back into the box you placed your items in.
[/list]

I don't know if this mod will work an android nor is it supported, if it
does work, Great! If it doesn't, then I can't help you, sorry.
Muiltplayer is also untested.


I do plan on supporting recolours/Building replacements but they will
take some time (I'm not a good artist), if you'd like to make a texture
for the building using Content Patcher then please go ahead, however if
you want me to add it into the mod, write a comment and we can see about
getting it added! (Seasonal variants are also accepted!)
